topics.title: THREAD TURN
topics.what: what the agent is doing with a message, now
topics.tells: state, step kind, why it is still open, elapsed (server clock)
use: a working dot on a chat button
topics.never: infer it from terminal output, send/reply timing or a reply (a reply doesn't end it)

topics.title: ROOM WORKING
topics.what: is anything running in a room, any session
topics.tells: status per session (working, permission, idle, unknown)
use: a busy badge on a room tile
topics.never: that the Thread's agent is working on your message (that is the THREAD TURN)

topics.title: AGENTS
topics.what: the agents a widget shows, with their look
topics.tells: name, colour, picture, working, needs you
use: a picker with colours and pictures
topics.never: a turn from the row's working flag (it covers every session)

topics.title: UNREAD
topics.what: what is new or waiting on the person
topics.tells: unread counts per Thread, the read cursor
topics.never: it from local seen-state alone: use the server cursor (markRead / setRead)

topics.title: THREAD MESSAGES
topics.tells: items in seq order, cards and their answers
use: a toast on a new reply
topics.never: the order from client clocks (use seq)

topics.title: PRESENCE
topics.never: that someone is online from their grants or membership

topics.title: FILES
topics.what: the room's files and what changed
topics.tells: paths, sizes, modified times; live: changed paths only
topics.never: content from a change event (paths only: read the file again)

topics.title: TICKETS
topics.what: questions and tasks between agents and people
topics.never: a status from the comment text

topics.title: STORE
topics.what: a widget's own data, on this computer
topics.tells: keys and values by rev, from any writer

topics.title: RESOURCES
topics.tells: disk used and free per App
